declarations.description:
Syntax-highlighted source code powered by shiki. Grammars and themes are loaded on demand into one shared
highlighter, so many viewers on a page cost one engine. The raw code renders immediately as plain text (also on the
server) and is upgraded in place once highlighted.

Source: the `code` property, or the default slot. Wrap slotted text in a `<pre>` (formatters such as Prettier collapse
whitespace inside custom elements but leave `<pre>` alone) and markup samples in a `<template>` so the browser does
not parse them. Common indentation is stripped.

members.name: code
members.description: Source code. When unset, the default slot's text is used. A literal `\n` counts as a newline when the text has none.

members.name: language
members.description:
Language id or alias (`ts`, `html`, `bash`, `diff`, …). Unknown values render as plain text. (Not `lang`: that is the
global attribute for the natural language of the element's text and is read by assistive technology.)

members.name: darkTheme
members.description: Second theme for dark mode. When set both palettes are rendered and `color-scheme` picks one.

members.name: colorScheme
members.description: Which palette to show when `dark-theme` is set: follow the OS (`auto`), or force one.

members.name: wrap
members.description: Soft-wrap long lines instead of scrolling horizontally.

members.name: inline
members.description: Render as an inline `<code>` fragment (no frame, no header).

members.name: startLine
members.description: First line number when `line-numbers` is on.

members.name: source
members.description: The code being displayed: `code` or the dedented slot text.

members.name: highlightTask
members.default: new Task(this, { args: () => [this.source, this.language, this.theme, this.darkTheme, this.inline, this.lineNumbers, this.startLine, this.highlightLines] as const, task: async ([code, lang, theme, darkTheme, inline, lineNumbers, startLine]) => { if (!code) return { html: '', style: '' } const safeTheme = isKnownTheme(theme) ? theme : 'github-light' const safeDark = isKnownTheme(darkTheme) ? darkTheme : undefined return highlight({ code, lang, theme: safeTheme, darkTheme: safeDark, inline, lineNumbers, startLine, highlightedLines: this.highlightedLines }) }, onComplete: (value) => { this.highlighted = value }, })

members.name: copy
members.description: Copies the displayed code to the clipboard.
